zh.title: 升级后检查 Nace 图片路由
zh.description: 托管端的 drex-v2.0 和 drex-max-v1.1 跟随 Max v1.2。已有设置不改写；旧 v2.0 主模型现在可能先于原备用模型接收图片。自定义端点行为不变。

zh.title: 在本机用 Chinese Decision 做中文判断
zh.description: 显式加载 Chinese Decision 0.8B 服务商，连接自己启动的 CPU 服务，对中文文本做是非判断、分类和评分。

zh.title: 按需试用 OpenRouter 免费决策路由
zh.description: 显式加载 OpenRouter 服务商，用 Perplexity Decider v1.3 免费路由做文本判断。请使用未配置供应商自带密钥（BYOK）的工作空间。

zh.title: 更新 Laya 本地开发探针
zh.description: 探针固定到 Laya 0.5.6，已验证首次安装和 CPU 中文推理。现有 Laya 路由和默认超时不变。

en.title: Check Nace image routing after upgrading
en.description: Hosted drex-v2.0 and drex-max-v1.1 now follow Max v1.2. Saved settings stay in place, but a v2.0 primary may now receive images before its previous fallback. Custom endpoints keep their existing behavior.

en.title: Run Chinese Decision locally
en.description: Load the optional Chinese Decision 0.8B provider and connect it to your own CPU server for yes/no judgments, classification, and scoring on Chinese text.

en.title: Try the OpenRouter free decision route
en.description: Load the optional OpenRouter provider to use the free Perplexity Decider v1.3 route for text. Use a workspace without bring-your-own provider keys (BYOK).

en.title: Update the local Laya development probe
en.description: The probe now pins Laya 0.5.6, verified from first-time setup through Chinese CPU inference. Existing Laya routes and the default timeout stay the same.
